create_GoogleCloudStorageObserver: create a GoogleCloudStorageObserver instance to log Sacred experiment results to a GCS bucket
validate_bucket_is_valid_bucket: validate a Google Cloud Storage bucket name against GCS naming rules using _is_valid_bucket
join_gcs_paths_gcs_join: join multiple GCS path segments into a single forward-slash separated path string using gcs_join
add_gcs_observer_gcs_option: add a GCS observer to a Sacred experiment run via the gcs_option CLI helper
log_metrics_log_metrics: log experiment metrics with values, steps, and timestamps to a metrics.json file on GCS
